texts.title: The Spymaster's Report
texts.body: {spymaster.name} does not write things down. The report on {watched.name} is given standing, in a low voice, in the time it takes to cross the room: what {watched.he} has under sail, what {watched.he} has banked, who dines with {watched.him}, and one thing besides that {watched.first} would pay a good deal to keep where it is.

choices.keep_it: Keep it for the day it is needed.
choices.sell_it: Sell it to whoever wants it most.
choices.tell_them: Tell {watched.him} what is being said in {watched.his} own house.

texts.title: The Informer Found
texts.body: He was a clerk in the household of {watched.name}, and for some years he was also {spymaster.name}'s. He has been found. {watched.first} has not said so in public, and has sent no word, which is its own kind of word.

choices.send_a_gift: Send a gift and admit nothing.
choices.stand_by_your_man: Tell the spymaster to send another.

texts.title: A Friend at Another Table
texts.body: {our_envoy.name} has been calling on {host.name} for long enough that the calls are no longer announced. This year {host.first} sent the servants out of the room and asked, as one asks a friend, what the house wanted.

choices.ask_for_a_vote: A vote, when the time comes.
choices.leave_it_warm: Nothing. Let it be a friendship.

texts.title: The Envoy Turned Away
texts.body: {our_envoy.name} was kept in the outer hall of {host.name} for the length of an afternoon and then told the head of the house was not at home. The gifts were taken in. The envoy was not.

texts.title: The Advocate's Day
texts.body: The praetor found for the house. {advocate.name} had pleaded it, and by the account of those who sat through it had pleaded it well. The other side's lawyer was seen afterwards reading the judgment a second time.

choices.reward_them: Pay {advocate.him} as a stranger would have been paid.
choices.take_the_credit: Let the benches know whose judgment it was.

texts.title: The Advocate Loses
texts.body: The praetor found against the house. {advocate.name} had pleaded it and came home without a word, and has been in the library since.

choices.pay_for_teaching: Pay for a year under a better lawyer.
choices.say_what_you_think: Say exactly how it was lost.

texts.title: The Chancellor's Voice
texts.body: {chancellor.name} declared the house on the year's business in the Senate, as you had left {chancellor.him} to. One of the votes has been remarked on, by people who would have expected the house to go the other way.

choices.make_it_yours: Say in the chamber that the votes were yours.
choices.ask_to_be_asked: Ask to be asked, next time.
